summary: Six tokens were reviewed, including two separate tokens at 95/51. Five supplied occurrences are already present as examples; only the ruler's 95/47 threat is added.
The court execution at 24/307 has active plural agents despite the edition's impersonal man. No Detransitive is inferred from that translation.
Detransitive Preterit ʕDimo and Detransitive Infectum gməʕdomo contrast with active L-agent/information-indexed forms. Ruined rug and Persian state share the same Detransitive meaning.
ʕdomo is a cognate Infinitiv intensifying gʕodámnola. The existing Detransitive Infinitiv location is retained as a glossary filing convention, not treated as semantic proof of Detransitive voice.
The missing Detransitive sense list and null example keys are supplied as structural proposals; no inherited wording or references are silently altered.

Should the cognate ʕdomo in the active 95/51 threat be moved from the inherited Detransitive Infinitiv box to the active Infinitiv box? The source establishes emphasis, while the current location may be an editorial convention.

Does I.2 execution extend to every threat against a human, or should 95/47 remain general destroy/kill unless formal judicial procedure is stated? It is filed as punitive execution provisionally; the court example at 24/307 is the clear anchor.
The ruḥo life/soul patient at 95/51 is resumed by feminine -la; destruction of life conveys the killing threat without changing the verb's destruction frame.
